paragraphs: R' Romanos. He lived in Rabbi’s time, as attested in Yerushalmi Bikkurim 1:5. Yerushalmi Megillah also names R' Romanos (cited here as 1:13, located at 1:11). Yerushalmi Shabbat, at the end of Kirah, describes Romanos taking a pan of coals from Rabbi’s house. Yerushalmi Yevamot, in He-Arel, halakhah 2, records Romanos on a separate mission for Rabbi. R' Zeira said that R' Assi said that R' Yohanan said that R' Hanina said: R' Romanos said, ‘Rabbi permitted it to me’: Kirah 47a. Rabbi sent R' Romanos: Yevamot 60b. Nedarim 38a: ‘Jonah paid its fare.’ R' Yohanan said he paid the whole ship's fare. R' Romanos said that a ship's fare was four thousand gold dinars.
